description: How a holder of the main-checkout mutex lets its own git child (and the hooks git runs) act under that lock, instead of FGOS_MAIN_LOCK_HOLDER_PID. The child inherits the locked description; nothing else can claim to be a borrower.

env.name: FGOS_LOCK_FD
env.meaning: <registry lock name>:<stdio slot holding the locked description>

rules: only the holder-lock facade maps a lock description into a child's stdio
the description is passed only after acquire succeeded
for git, the API always inserts -c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false before the subcommand, so no background gc inherits the description
the holder waits for the child to exit before it treats the transaction as done

allOf: FGOS_LOCK_FD names main-checkout and the slot
fstat(slot) has the same dev:ino as the main-checkout lock file
borrowerCheck.otherwise: not a borrower: the hook probes main-checkout once with its own description and refuses when it is held; it never waits

mayNot: release the lock for the holder (closing its copy releases nothing while the holder keeps its own)
pass the description on beyond git's own hooks

scrub: workerBaseEnv drops FGOS_LOCK_FD; a leaked env var without the description gives nothing
